title: A scheme carrying an ample invertible module is separated
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal L$ an ample invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Then $X$ is separated, i.e. the structure morphism $X\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism]. (More generally the conclusion holds as soon as every point of $X$ lies in an affine open $X_s$ for some $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$, $n\ge1$; quasi-compactness of $X$ is not used.)
